I put the ANYCUBIC Kobra X through a 72-hour nonstop printing marathon.

4 colors by default.
Multi-material support.
Less waste with ACE Gen 2.

Three full days of continuous printing to test stability, color switching, and long-run reliability.

Please note: this is an early sample unit. The final production version may have minor cosmetic differences.

Built for beginners exploring multi-color 3D printing and experienced makers who want faster, more efficient color changes.
